output.summary: A deciduous tropical tree native to parts of tropical Asia and Oceania, it bears red, five-petalled flowers in spring before new leaves appear. Its ripe seed capsules contain white cotton-like fibres, while the trunk bears spikes, especially when young.
output.edibilityNote: Flowers are dried and cooked in Myanmar; dried flower cores flavour Thai soups and curry, and flower-bud calyxes were historically eaten in India.
